Multidisciplinary Collaboration in the Performance of Aortic Surgery: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
papers.summary: This AHA scientific statement looks at aortic surgery from the separate viewpoints of the surgeon, anaesthesiologist and perfusionist. It highlights how one team member's actions immediately affect the others, especially with single-lung ventilation, systemic cooling and rewarming, and myocardial, cerebral and visceral protection. It is illustrative rather than exhaustive and reports no new data.
